items.description:
Doodles Beachfront is a restaurant and function venue on the beachfront in Bloubergstrand, with panoramic views of Table Mountain and the bay. The sun sets beyond Robben Island, and the enclosed lower deck makes outdoor dining comfortable in all weather.

The menu includes an a la carte selection, a snack platter menu and a pensioners menu, along with an extensive wine list. The venue has live music, and the business says it offers set menus and platter options for private functions.

The kitchen serves breakfast, lunch, light meals and dinner, and the team says the setting, live music and service combine into a memorable evening.

It suits groups and families who want a lively meal with a view across the bay in Bloubergstrand.

Engen False Bay 1 Stop is a fuel and convenience forecourt on the N2 at Macassar, on the route between Cape Town and Somerset West. Alongside its diesel and petrol bays the station operates as a petroleum products outlet with its own oil-change service, and houses a Wimpy and a Woolworths Food counter for travellers who want a hot meal or quick groceries without leaving the forecourt.

Customer reviews describe the site as clean and the service as fast and friendly, with a self-service coffee machine available between fill-ups. The forecourt trades around the clock, open 24 hours a day, which suits long-distance drivers, shift workers and anyone passing through Macassar outside normal shopping hours looking for fuel, a snack or a sit-down meal on the N2 corridor.

items.description:
Harringtons Cocktail Lounge is a cocktail bar on Harrington Street in Cape Town's District Six, run as an upstairs lounge rather than a conventional restaurant. Regulars describe reasonable pricing, good food and an enjoyable vibe, built around a Wednesday tapas evening that pairs small plates with wine, plus occasional supper-and-tasting nights built around a visiting wine estate.

The lounge keeps a later, nightlife-driven rhythm than a typical bar, trading from mid-afternoon into the small hours from Wednesday through to Saturday. It suits drinkers and diners after cocktails with a tapas-style food offering and a late-night setting in the East City area, rather than an early sit-down dinner crowd looking for a quiet table.

items.description:
JEM Hair and Beauty Studio is a hair salon at 3-Arts Village on Main Road in Plumstead, Cape Town. Its team of more than 14 practitioners offers hair colouring, highlights, hair treatments and standard hair services, along with lash services, manicures, pedicures and nail services.

The studio also offers waxing, tinting, threading, basin treatments and a footlogix treatment. Its wash, cut and blow-dry packages are popular, and the business runs seasonal promotions. The salon is rated 4.9 out of five on Fresha from more than 6,600 reviews, and reviewers often mention the head massages and personal attention.

It suits clients who want a wide range of hair and beauty services in one visit at the Plumstead village centre.

Kommetjie Surf Shop, trading online as Komsurf, is a surf, skate and lifestyle retailer on Erika Road in Kommetjie. Its range runs across surfboards, wetsuits and surf accessories alongside skate gear and lifestyle clothing, and the shop also stocks its own in-house labels within a wider shop-by-brand selection, plus gift cards for customers who aren't sure exactly what to buy.

Beyond retail, the shop runs surf lessons and board rentals, giving newcomers a way into the water alongside regulars restocking their kit. Based at 1 Erika Road in Kommetjie, it suits surfers, skaters and anyone after cold-water surf equipment and gear on the Cape Peninsula, whether buying outright or renting for a session.

Kromboom Dental Centre is a dental practice in Rondebosch East, Cape Town, which describes its approach as patient first. Its services include consultations, child-friendly dentistry for patients aged 12 and under, wisdom tooth removal, and fixed and removable orthodontics for adults and children.

The practice offers advanced root canal treatment using a surgical microscope, Philips Zoom tooth whitening, and after-hours emergency care, and it says it uses state-of-the-art equipment. A full list of services is on its website.

The practice is contracted out of medical aid, so patients settle the bill after treatment and claim from their medical aid. Since March 2025 it has charged a small percentage above medical aid rates for most treatments, which is payable out of pocket.

items.description:
Las Paletas is a flavour-driven design studio in Killarney Gardens, Cape Town, which began as one of the city's first artisan ice cream brands around 2012. The studio now turns ice cream into immersive brand experiences that go beyond the product, translating a brand's theme and essence into a sensory moment for guests.

Its work covers fashion brands, sporting events, black-tie galas and brand activations, and the team says it will shape a bespoke experience from a brief. Sister brands include Flossy and Frose, Torch and Fluff, and La Colombiana.

The studio suits brands, event organisers and businesses that want a memorable, flavour-led experience in Cape Town.

items.description:
Mugg and Bean Paddocks is a branch of the Mugg and Bean coffee and dining chain, in Shops 19 and 20 at Paddocks Shopping Centre on Racecourse Road, Milnerton. The branch serves freshly brewed coffee, all-day breakfast, brunch, lunch, muffins and cakes made from scratch, along with bottomless drinks.

Guests can dine in, take away or order online, and the branch offers counter service, debit card payments and dessert. The branch describes itself as a place where customers become regulars and regulars become friends.

It suits families, friends and colleagues who want a relaxed breakfast, brunch or lunch at Paddocks Shopping Centre.

The Mussel Monger & Oyster Bar is a seafood stall and oyster bar inside Mojo Market on Regent Road in Sea Point, specialising in fresh mussels and oysters. Mussels are sold live from 2kg upward, and oysters come in packs ranging from a dozen to five dozen, so portions scale from a quick snack to a full table of shellfish for a group.

Beyond the counter, the business offers delivery for customers who would rather eat at home, and has taken its shellfish out to beach pop-up events around Cape Town. It also trades from sister branches at Riverlands Mall in Observatory and Oranjezicht Market at the V&A Waterfront. The Sea Point branch inside Mojo Market suits seafood lovers after fresh oysters and mussels without booking a full sit-down meal.

items.description:
The Old Cape Wine Shop is a boutique wine store on Imhoff Farm in Kommetjie, stocking a curated selection of South African wines from a wide range of regions, cultivars and terroirs. The shop describes its service as expertly selected wines with professional purchasing advice.

The shop knows the farms and winemakers personally, and nothing reaches the shelves without being tasted first. The range includes small-batch and boutique wineries, once-off winemakers' releases and wines sold on allocation, along with sparkling wine for celebrations.

The shop sits among the farm's newly planted vineyards, and it suits wine lovers who want personal guidance rather than an online cellar.

items.description:
Petworld XXL Diep River is a pet store at 89 Main Road in Diep River, part of the Petworld chain. The branch stocks dog food and treats, toys, health products, bowls and dispensers, beds and blankets, clothing, travel and safety items, and behaviour and training products.

The store also offers Groomworld grooming services, and the branch describes its team as expert and ready to help. In-store promotions run in a space that welcomes pets. The branch is one of several Petworld stores in the Cape Town area, including the Petworld XXL Somerset West and Express stores in Sea Point, Table Bay Mall and Rondebosch.

It suits dog owners in Diep River and the surrounding suburbs who want supplies, grooming and advice under one roof.

items.description:
Salon Jean Paul is a hair salon at Shop 9 in Cavalier Shopping Centre on Robert Sobukwe Road, Belhar. Its service list covers balayage, curly-hair styling, hair braiding, colouring, extensions, keratin treatments, perms, permanent straightening and women's haircuts, stretching from a single colour touch-up to a full change of style in one visit.

Services are booked individually rather than as set packages, so clients can choose exactly what they need, whether that's a one-off treatment before an event or a regular colour and cut routine. Based in the Cavalier Shopping Centre, the salon suits women in Belhar looking for a full range of hair services, from everyday cuts to more involved colour and texture work, under one roof.

items.description:
Shopmate Fish Traders is a fresh and frozen seafood supplier based in Retreat, supplying restaurants and retail stores across the Western Cape. The business sources its stock from reliable, sustainable suppliers and delivers to customers daily, running as a wholesale operation rather than a walk-in retail counter.

Founded in 2007, Shopmate has built its business around consistent daily deliveries to the hospitality and retail trade rather than direct sales to the public. Operating from Joseph Anderson Street in Retreat, it suits restaurants, fish shops and other food retailers across the Western Cape who need a dependable wholesale supplier of fresh and frozen seafood rather than a single supplier for one-off orders.

items.description:
Snow White Laundry Service is a laundromat on Main Road in Diep River offering drop-and-go washing, drying and folding, charged by weight rather than a flat fee. Customers regularly drop off a load in the morning and collect it clean the same day, and the business also takes on bulky items such as duvets and blankets that are awkward to wash at home.

Reviewers describe the staff as friendly and efficient, quick to flag any delays, and the service has also been called on for larger jobs such as deep-cleaning laundry left behind by a previous tenant. Alongside households, it serves Airbnb hosts, schools and clinics in the area that need linen washed reliably. It trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and Saturdays until 2pm.

Stud. The Burger Shop is a burger restaurant on Main Road in Sea Point, built around a short menu of burgers, chips and drinks rather than a sprawling all-day offering. Options range from a double-stacked boran beef patty with double cheese to a fully plant-based burger made with a vegan patty, vegan cheese and vegan mayo, so meat-eaters and plant-based diners can order from the same counter.

Chips come dusted with a secret spice mix, and the menu runs to combo deals alongside beer and soft drinks for a simple sit-down or takeaway meal. The Sea Point branch carries a strong customer rating built on more than a thousand online orders and is tagged as group friendly. It suits casual diners after a quick, consistent burger rather than a long restaurant sitting.

items.description:
The Men's Room is a barbershop on Main Road in Diep River built around a relaxed, no-fuss grooming experience aimed specifically at men. Services include haircuts, hot-towel shaves, facials and scalp-massage treatments, delivered in what the business describes as a hip, comfortable setting for clients who want to look their best without a fussy salon atmosphere.

Clients can book online rather than phoning ahead, and the barbershop runs a rewards card for regulars who come back for repeat visits. Since opening in Diep River, the business has grown to a second branch in Fish Hoek. It suits men looking for straightforward, professional barbering and grooming at an accessible price, rather than a high-end spa experience.

items.description:
The Thirsty Oyster Tavern is a seafood restaurant in the historic Old Harbour in Gordon's Bay. The business says it has grown over going on 24 years from a fisherman's pub into a well-patronised seafood restaurant, and its kitchen has been enlarged three times.

The restaurant has an enclosed entrance deck, a larger dining area and an upstairs deck with a view over False Bay and Table Mountain. Dishes are cooked from scratch, and there is live music on weekends.

It suits diners who want a relaxed seafood meal with harbour views and sunsets in Gordon's Bay. The tavern does not take email bookings, so guests are asked to book by phone.

Tokai Forest Guest House is a small guest house on Dennendal East Avenue, set at the base of the Constantiaberg Mountains with Tokai Forest directly behind the property. Run by a small family team, the guest house has recently been refurbished after a break of several years and reopened with a brighter, lighter look while keeping its home-from-home character.

Guests can head straight from the property into the forest for mountain-bike excursions, making it a natural base for visitors who want to combine accommodation with time outdoors. Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Tokai, it suits travellers after a smaller, more personal guest house rather than a large hotel, with the forest on their doorstep.

Unframed Ice Cream is an artisanal ice cream maker with a production kitchen and shop in the Woodstock Quarter on Sir Lowry Road. The brand was founded in 2016 by someone who left a career in finance to pursue a passion for ice cream, going on to train alongside one of the most respected names in the craft, and describes its mission as bringing the art back into artisan ice cream making.

The Woodstock Quarter store opened in March 2020, selling the brand's small-batch flavours, including vegan and dairy options, from a dedicated shop unit on the ground level. It trades through the afternoon and early evening from Monday to Saturday. It suits dessert-lovers after adventurous, small-batch ice cream rather than a standard commercial tub.

Walsh Fireplaces, trading as Victorian Fireplaces and Cape Chimneys, is a small fireplace company in Retreat, Cape Town, that makes bespoke fireplaces. Its main focus is traditional built-in fireplaces made from firebricks and the mantelpieces around them, along with Victorian and marble mantelpieces.

The company refurbishes and repairs Victorian fireplaces and their surrounds, and makes hearths from granite, slate, marble or sandstone. Fire grates and ironmongery are made to order so that they fit each fireplace, and it also supplies chimney pots, wrought-iron grates and parts for Victorian fireplaces.

It keeps firedogs, old-fashioned grates and Victorian fireplaces in stock and has a showroom where customers can view samples. It suits homeowners who want a bespoke or period fireplace.
